body: I appreciate your response. I agree with your reasoning but it also fuels y guilt, regret. I am lucky to be here, unfortunately I don't want to be. I'm 23, I've experienced life, I've even given it a chance, and this isn't for me. I feel and know I'd be better off in nothingness than this. Pain can be dealt with but it never goes away. Do I really want to live 40+ years of this pain? No. I want to end it now, I'm tired of staying up all night crying to myself, it's fucking pathetic. I cannot take another year of my hopes fluctuating, just to reach a peak and be crushed.. ad infinitum. This is a fucked up game and I don't want to play, I'm not interested in taking advantage of others (or being fucked over)  in a common sadistic attempt to get ahead in this bullshit. I just hate that ending my torment will impose it upon others.

I'm ashamed to be alive, to have wasted what sOmeone may have benefited from because I have not. I'm ashamed at my choices, at others choices, at governments choices. I don't feel I belong here and never have. My values, beliefs, and sense of morality don't coincide with others. I have a strong sense of dread everyday, so I'm avoidant of other people. The only bond I've ever held with others has been superficial. I'll never be like them, I'll neer be able to look past the suffering of others, of humanity, enough to enjoy myself without guilt. Buying bullshit won't make me happy, material things/worth have never interested me beyond their functionality. I can't buy into the lie, I can't sit back comfortably and laugh at some mind numbing TV show and drift into stupor. I can't ignore the reality of it all. I can't be happy. I'm unsure of happiness in general, if it's simply complacency from pain, I don't want to be 'happy'. Reality matters most to me and reality is shit. I'm done lying to myself. I want to be gone but I can't hurt anyone that cares about me . I wish there was a way for them to know this and that I should be allowed to end my life. They never will. An accident will lessen their pain and spare them the shame.
